guard: Existing manager authority refuses environment-family gates before effect; ordinary caller selection excludes that family and plain preparation reserves its native family
why: The suite drives the hosted auth service and authority plane on a private JWT broker. Stock fixture registration reaches caller selection, human renewal, maintenance, run and delegated decisions. This is not environment admission or hosted execution. Named breadth mutations complete every new cell and teardown.

mutations.name: ordinary caller admits an environment-family gate

mutations.cell: ordinary manager-caller refuses a registered environment instance

mutations.name: ordinary selection counts environment-family gates
mutations.find:
const row = parseEndpointGate(raw.data, raw.key);
      if (row.authorityFamily === "environment-manager") continue;
mutations.expectRed: mixed families leave ordinary explicit and automatic selection usable
mutations.cell: mixed families leave ordinary explicit and automatic selection usable

mutations.cell: human renewStandingBundle refuses an environment registration
